items.a: The account is free. You pay only for the lab's work — at a price you see before sending, which the lab confirms in writing.
Not yet — for now we work with digital impressions only: you attach the scan files to the order. Physical impressions are on the roadmap.

items.q: How does a lab get listed?
items.a: It signs up and fills in its profile — services, prices, turnaround times. We review and approve it, and only then do doctors see the lab.

items.q: Can I change an order after sending it?
items.a: Yes — until the case is closed. The lab sees exactly what changed and confirms the price and due date again.
